d: Elon Musk is exploring a merger of Tesla and SpaceX, a deal that could create a company worth roughly $3.5 trillion. Both companies have formed special committees to study the proposal. The business case is clear: Tesla brings electric cars, robots and self-driving technology, while SpaceX brings rockets, satellites, data centres and communications networks. But the deal could also give Musk more control. SpaceX’s super-voting shares give him far greater voting power than he has at Tesla. Any merger would still need shareholder approval and could face major regulatory scrutiny.
